suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python: setup.py url points to a repository that returns 404
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

At revision `65b1f577c0f16d0d9112bb6c1153d3024543ac02`, `setup.py` sets `url` to `https://github.com/aspose-3d/Aspose.3D-for-Python`. That address answers HTTP 404. PyPI shows the same address as the Homepage of `aspose-3d-foss` 26.1.0, so the package's only link to its source leads to a page that does not exist.

## Environment

- Repository: aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Python
- Revision: `65b1f577c0f16d0d9112bb6c1153d3024543ac02` (the upstream revision this report was verified against, default branch `master`)
- Verified on 2026-10-11 from a fresh shallow clone; the PyPI read is the public JSON API.

## Steps to reproduce

```
grep -n 'url=' setup.py
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://github.com/aspose-3d/Aspose.3D-for-Python
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Python
curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/aspose-3d-foss/json | python -c 'import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)["info"]; print(i["home_page"], i["project_urls"])'
```

## Expected

`setup.py` `url` points to this repository, `https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Python`, which answers HTTP 200, so the package page on PyPI links to the source.

## Actual

- `setup.py:15` is `url="https://github.com/aspose-3d/Aspose.3D-for-Python"`, which answers HTTP 404.
- `https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Python` answers HTTP 200.
- PyPI `aspose-3d-foss` 26.1.0 lists `https://github.com/aspose-3d/Aspose.3D-for-Python` as `home_page` and as `project_urls['Homepage']`; no other URL is listed.

## Suggested fix

Set `url` in `setup.py` to `https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Python` (a `project_urls` mapping with `Repository` and `Issues` entries would also help) and publish a release, since PyPI shows the metadata of the release only.
